text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... I'm beat!
I really pushed these old bones to their limit today.
choice_data_list: You're hardly an old woman, are you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The nuance is right, so it's fine!
It was pretty tough, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I've come this far.
Maybe I can hold my own a little... or not.

Nice Nature is probably envisioning
the battle awaiting her at the rapidly approaching Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You said it, okay~? Then,if it turns out completely useless, you'll have to take responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna find a super expensive place for either sukiyaki or fugu shabu-shabu.

—And so, the fulfilling summer training camp
with Nice Nature came to an end.
